name: PostgreSQL OTel Monitoring
description: Comprehensive PostgreSQL monitoring dashboard using nrpostgresqlreceiver metrics. Covers database overview, slow and active queries, transactions, row operations, tables and indexes, buffer cache, background writer, locks, and replication/WAL/vector. Multi-entity support via entity_name variable (entity.name), compliant with OTel semantic conventions.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT average(`postgresql.backends`) WHERE metricName = 'postgresql.backends' AND otel.library.name IN ('github.com/newrelic-forks/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/nrpostgresqlreceiver', 'github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/postgresqlreceiver') AND entity.name IN ({{entity_name}}) FACET db.namespace TIMESERIES

FROM Metric SELECT latest(`postgresql.connection.max`) WHERE metricName = 'postgresql.connection.max' AND otel.library.name IN ('github.com/newrelic-forks/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/nrpostgresqlreceiver', 'github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/postgresqlreceiver') AND entity.name IN ({{entity_name}}) FACET entity.name

FROM Metric SELECT average(`postgresql.database.count`) WHERE metricName = 'postgresql.database.count' AND otel.library.name IN ('github.com/newrelic-forks/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/nrpostgresqlreceiver', 'github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/postgresqlreceiver') AND entity.name IN ({{entity_name}}) FACET entity.name TIMESERIES

FROM Metric SELECT latest(`postgresql.db_size`)/1073741824 AS 'DB Size (GB)' WHERE metricName = 'postgresql.db_size' AND otel.library.name IN ('github.com/newrelic-forks/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/nrpostgresqlreceiver', 'github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/postgresqlreceiver') AND entity.name IN ({{entity_name}}) FACET db.namespace

FROM Metric SELECT average(`postgresql.table.count`) WHERE metricName = 'postgresql.table.count' AND otel.library.name IN ('github.com/newrelic-forks/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/nrpostgresqlreceiver', 'github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/postgresqlreceiver') AND entity.name IN ({{entity_name}}) FACET db.namespace TIMESERIES

FROM DbServerTopQuery SELECT sum(postgresql.calls) WHERE otel.library.name IN ('github.com/newrelic-forks/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/nrpostgresqlreceiver', 'github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/postgresqlreceiver') AND entity.name IN ({{entity_name}}) FACET db.namespace TIMESERIES LIMIT MAX SINCE 30 minutes ago UNTIL now

FROM DbServerTopQuery SELECT sum(postgresql.total_exec_time)/sum(postgresql.calls) AS 'avgDuration' WHERE otel.library.name IN ('github.com/newrelic-forks/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/nrpostgresqlreceiver', 'github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/postgresqlreceiver') AND entity.name IN ({{entity_name}}) FACET db.namespace TIMESERIES LIMIT MAX SINCE 30 minutes ago UNTIL now

FROM DbServerTopQuery SELECT latest(db.query.text) AS 'queryText', latest(db.namespace) AS 'databaseName', sum(postgresql.calls) AS 'totalExecutions', sum(postgresql.total_exec_time) / sum(postgresql.calls) AS 'avgDuration', sum(postgresql.shared_blks_hit) + sum(postgresql.shared_blks_read) AS 'logicalReads' WHERE otel.library.name IN ('github.com/newrelic-forks/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/nrpostgresqlreceiver', 'github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/postgresqlreceiver') AND entity.name IN ({{entity_name}}) FACET postgresql.queryid

FROM DbServerQuerySample SELECT count(*) AS 'Samples' WHERE otel.library.name IN ('github.com/newrelic-forks/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/nrpostgresqlreceiver', 'github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/postgresqlreceiver') AND entity.name IN ({{entity_name}}) AND postgresql.wait_event IS NOT NULL AND postgresql.wait_event != '' FACET postgresql.wait_event TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT MAX

FROM DbServerQuerySample SELECT latest(postgresql.query_start) AS 'startTime', latest(postgresql.query_id) AS 'queryHash', latest(db.namespace) AS 'databaseName', latest(postgresql.total_exec_time)/1000 AS 'duration', latest(db.query.text) AS 'queryText', latest(user.name) AS 'callingUser', latest(network.peer.address) AS 'hostName', latest(postgresql.wait_event) AS 'waitEvent', latest(postgresql.blocking.wait_duration) AS 'waitTime' WHERE otel.library.name IN ('github.com/newrelic-forks/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/nrpostgresqlreceiver', 'github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/postgresqlreceiver') AND entity.name IN ({{entity_name}}) AND db.query.text != '' FACET postgresql.pid, postgresql.query_start

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(`postgresql.commits`), 1 SECOND) WHERE metricName = 'postgresql.commits' AND otel.library.name IN ('github.com/newrelic-forks/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/nrpostgresqlreceiver', 'github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/postgresqlreceiver') AND entity.name IN ({{entity_name}}) FACET db.namespace TIMESERIES

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(`postgresql.tup_fetched`), 1 SECOND) WHERE metricName = 'postgresql.tup_fetched' AND otel.library.name IN ('github.com/newrelic-forks/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/nrpostgresqlreceiver', 'github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/postgresqlreceiver') AND entity.name IN ({{entity_name}}) FACET db.namespace TIMESERIES

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(`postgresql.tup_returned`), 1 SECOND) WHERE metricName = 'postgresql.tup_returned' AND otel.library.name IN ('github.com/newrelic-forks/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/nrpostgresqlreceiver', 'github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/postgresqlreceiver') AND entity.name IN ({{entity_name}}) FACET db.namespace TIMESERIES

FROM Metric SELECT average(`postgresql.table.size`)/1073741824 AS 'Size (GB)' WHERE metricName = 'postgresql.table.size' AND otel.library.name IN ('github.com/newrelic-forks/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/nrpostgresqlreceiver', 'github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/postgresqlreceiver') AND entity.name IN ({{entity_name}}) FACET db.collection.name

nrqlQuery.query: FROM Metric SELECT uniques(entity.name) WHERE otel.library.name IN ('github.com/newrelic-forks/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/nrpostgresqlreceiver', 'github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/postgresqlreceiver')
